ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $ \angle AOB=40^\circ$, $OB$ is the bisector of $ \angle AOC$, and $OD$ is the bisector of $ \angle COE$. If $ \angle DOE=10^\circ$, find the degree measure of $ \angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $OB$ is the bisector of $\angle AOC$, and $OD$ is the bisector of $\angle COE$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOC=\angle AOB=40^\circ$, $\angle COD=\angle DOE=10^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOD=\angle BOC+\angle COD=40^\circ+10^\circ=\boxed{50^\circ}$.
